  [ 1005f]      #ifdef GL_ES\n
                precision mediump float;\n
                #endif\n
                varying vec4 v_fragmentColor;\n
                varying vec2 v_texCoord;\n
                uniform sampler2D u_texture;\n
                uniform vec3 u_lum;\n
                void main(void) {\n
                    vec4 color = texture2D(u_texture, v_texCoord);\n
                    float gray = dot(color.rgb * v_fragmentColor.rgb, u_lum);\n
                    float normalization = (v_fragmentColor.r + v_fragmentColor.g + v_fragmentColor.b) / 3.0;\n
                    gray /= normalization;  // Adjust for tint brightness\n
                    gl_FragColor = vec4(v_fragmentColor.rgb*vec3(gray), color.a * v_fragmentColor.a);\n
                }\n

                #endif                                                          \n
                \n
                varying vec4 v_fragmentColor;                \n
                varying vec2 v_texCoord;                                    \n
                uniform sampler2D u_texture;                                \n
                uniform mat3 u_hue;                                         \n
                uniform float u_alpha;                                      \n
                \n
                void main()                                                 \n

                vec4 pixColor = texture2D(u_texture, v_texCoord);       \n
                vec3 rgbColor = u_hue * pixColor.rgb * v_fragmentColor.rgb;                   \n
                gl_FragColor = vec4(rgbColor, pixColor.a * u_alpha);    \n
                }                                                           \n

  [ 3006d]  Settings
  [ 30076]  Help
  [ 3007b]  <cg>Unlisted</c> makes it so that your level can only be found by <cy>searching for the exact ID</c>. It will <cr>not</c> be visible on your profile, from search, or anywhere else. Unlisted levels do <cr>not</c> have to be <cp>verified</c> to be uploaded.\n
            <co>Friends Only</c> makes it so that only <cl>friends</c> who search the exact ID can find it.
  [ 301db]  Unlisted
  [ 301e4]  Friends Only
  [ 301f1]  Starting in 2.2, all new levels are free to copy.\n
            (Older levels retain any copy settings.)
  [ 3024c]  0070
  [ 30251]  An unlisted level can only be found by entering its levelID. Once a level is unlisted, it cannot change back to listed.

  [ 302e4]  Info
  [ 302e9]  <cg>Green</c> users are unregistered.\n
            <cy>Gold</c> users are unique registered.\n
            <cl>Blue</c> songs are official.\n
            <cp>Purple</c> songs are custom.
  [ 3037b]  Lists
  [ 30381]  A <co>list</c> may have rewards if it is rated by RobTop. The difficulty face is manually set by the creator of the list.\n
            Usernames are <cy>gold</c> for registered users and <cg>green</c> for unregistered users. A song is <cl>blue</c> if it is official and <cp>pink</c> if it is custom.
  [ 304a0]  Top Lists
  [ 304aa]  These <co>lists</c> have been rated by RobTop. The rewards for each one are also decided by him and are variable from list to list. Note that rated lists can only be <cy>Featured</c> and do not reward Creator Points.
  [ 30583]  Levels
  [ 3058a]  A <co>level</c> rewards <cy>Stars</c> if it is rated by RobTop. For unrated levels, the difficulty face is set by community votes on each level's page. This is also how <cr>Demon</c> difficulties are decided.\n
            Usernames are <cy>gold</c> for registered users and <cg>green</c> for unregistered users. A song is <cl>blue</c> if it is official and <cp>pink</c> if it is custom.
  [ 30700]  Levels on this list have been rated and featured by RobTop. The extra visual around the difficulty face indicates how much he likes a specific level. In order of increasing quality:\n
            <cy>Featured</c>, <co>Epic</c>, <cp>Legendary</c>, and <cj>Mythic</c>.
  [ 307fd]  Map Packs
  [ 30807]  <cg>Map Packs</c> are collections of 3 rated levels of similar difficulty set by RobTop. Once completed, they reward <cy>Stars</c> and <cl>Secret Coins</c>.
  [ 308a4]  Weekly Levels

  [ 3544b]  Click On Steps

  [ 3545f]  Allows you to click on every step, regardless of your refresh rate. This is beneficial for users below 240 Hz.

  [ 3580d]  Toggles between main and secondary color for the teleport effect in spider mode.
  [ 3585e]  Switch Dash\n
            Fire Color
  [ 35875]  Toggles between main and secondary color for the fire effect from dash orbs.
  [ 358c2]  Switch Wave\n
            Trail Color
  [ 358da]  Toggles between main and secondary color for the trail in wave mode.
  [ 3591f]  Hide Playtest Text
  [ 35932]  Hides text in the top left when using start positions or ignore damage.
  [ 3597a]  Hitbox On Death
  [ 3598a]  Shows hitboxes upon death in both normal and practice mode.
  [ 359c6]  Hides the attempt counter when playing levels in practice mode.

  [ 35a1e]  Places checkpoints automatically in practice mode.

            Checkpoints

  [ 35a6f]  Tries to place checkpoints more often in practice mode.

  [ 35abb]  Shows death effects in practice mode.
  [ 35ae1]  Enable Normal Music\n
            In Editor
  [ 35aff]  Plays normal music in sync to editor levels in practice mode.
  [ 35b3d]  Shows hitboxes while in practice mode.
  [ 35b64]  Disable Player Hitbox
  [ 35b7a]  Disables the player's hitbox in practice mode\n
            (if hitboxes are shown).
  [ 35bc1]  Enable Smooth Fix
  [ 35bd3]  Makes some optimizations that can reduce lag. Disable if game speed becomes inconsistent.
  [ 35c2d]  Increase Draw Capacity
  [ 35c44]  0066
  [ 35c49]  Increases draw capacity for batch nodes at level start. Can improve performance on some levels, but may cause issues on low-end devices.
  [ 35cd2]  Enable Low Detail
  [ 35ce4]  Enables low detail mode on levels that support it automatically.
  [ 35d25]  Disable High Object\n
            Alert
  [ 35d3f]  Removes the alert shown when starting levels with a high object count.
  [ 35d86]  Enable Extra LDM
  [ 35d97]  0136
  [ 35d9c]  Removes glow and enter effects while in low detail mode. Levels without LDM show LDM Lite.
  [ 35df7]  Increase Maximum\n
            Levels
  [ 35e0f]  Increases maximum locally saved levels from 10 to 100. This refers to level data, not statistics. Enabling this can make your save file considerably larger, so keeping the option off is recommended for quicker saving.
  [ 35ee9]  Disable Level Saving
  [ 35efe]  Saves level statistics as usual, but levels need to be redownloaded every time you restart the game. Makes saving and loading faster.
  [ 35f84]  Save Gauntlets
  [ 35f93]  Saves gauntlet levels locally so they do not have to be redownloaded. Increases save time but helpful if you have poor connection.
  [ 36016]  Disable Shader\n

  [ 36033]  0155
  [ 36038]  Disables anti-aliasing on shader effects.
  [ 36062]  Disable Song Alert
  [ 36075]  Removes the alert shown when starting levels without the song downloaded.
  [ 360bf]  No Song Limit
  [ 360cd]  Stops automatic deletion of custom songs. This is done by default to save space.
  [ 3611e]  Reduce Quality\n
            (Read Info)
  [ 36139]  Lowers audio sampling rate from 44100 Hz to 24000 Hz. Requires restarting to take effect.
  [ 36193]  Audio Fix 01
  [ 361a0]  Increases the audio buffer size, which may fix certain issues. Do not enable if audio is working fine. Causes a slight more audio delay. Requires restarting to take effect.

  [ 4aeba]  Creators
  [ 4aec3]  The <cg>Creators</c> leaderboard is sorted by amount of Creator Points. Creating a rated level rewards 1, <cy>Featured</c> rewards 2, <co>Epic</c> rewards 3, <cp>Legendary</c> rewards 4, and <cj>Mythic</c> rewards 5.
  [ 4af9c]  Global

  [ 4e801]  Hold To Swipe
  [ 4e80f]  Enables swiping after holding down anywhere on the grid for a short duration. Useful when selecting objects without the need to toggle swiping manually.
  [ 4e8a8]  Swipe Cycle Mode
  [ 4e8b9]  Cycles through touched objects instead of adding to selection when tapping in the same position while swiping is enabled. Useful if you want to select multiple objects that are mixed with other objects.
  [ 4e984]  Layer Locking
  [ 4e992]  Allows you to click on the editor layer number to lock and unlock a layer.
  [ 4e9dd]  Show Clicks
  [ 4e9e9]  Shows a marker during playtesting when the player clicks.
  [ 4ea23]  Auto-Pause
  [ 4ea2e]  Pauses gameplay when starting from a start position to prepare gameplay. Click a second time to actually start playing. This is used to handle start lag in larger levels.
  [ 4ead9]  Hide Path
  [ 4eae3]  Hides the player path from playtesting.
  [ 4eb0b]  Start Optimization
  [ 4eb1e]  Tries to speed up start position loading in editor. Experimental.

  [ 589a4]  Z Layer
  [ 589ac]  <cg>Add</c> assigns up to 10 groups to the selected object(s).\n
             <cy>P</c> sets a single object as group parent.\n
            <cl>Editor L1 and L2</c> places the object(s) on an editor layer.\n
            <cp>Z layer</c> sets the draw layer of the object(s). T layers are above, while B layers are below the player.\n
            <cr>Z order</c> sets the draw order of the object(s) within the Z layer.\n
            <ca>CH</c> sets the channel of the object(s).\n
            <co>ORD</c> sets the order of the object(s).\n
            <cj>Extra</c> has more advanced options.\n
            <cg>Preview</c> makes touch toggled triggers preview in editor.\n
            <cy>Playback</c> starts playback from this object.

  [ 59ece]  Setup Scale Command
  [ 59ee2]  <cg>Scales</c> a specific <cy>Target Group ID</c>.\n
            <cl>Center Group ID</c> specifies a target object to use as the center. If none is set, all objects use their own center.\n
            <cp>Duration</c> specifies how long the scaling lasts.\n
            <cr>Div by Value X/Y</c> divides the current scale by the values.\n
            <co>Only Move</c> makes the objects move as if they were scaled.\n
            <ca>Relative Rotation</c> rotates the X- and Y-axis too.\n
            <cj>Relative Scale</c> bases scaling on the reference object.
  [ 5a0c0]  Only\n

  [ 5a111]  Song Trigger
  [ 5a11e]  Lets you start a specified <cg>song</c>.\n
            A single track can be active in each <cy>Channel</c> at a time.\n
            <cl>Start, End, FadeIn, and FadeOut</c> are in milliseconds.\n
            <cp>Prep</c> is used to ensure exact sync to a specified time as there may be some delay loading it normally. Use this option on a trigger to prepare the song before you want it to start, and then use <cr>Load Prep</c> when you want it to start. Note that only one Prep can be active at a time per channel.

            // ---------------------\n
            // SHOCKWAVE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_shockWaveTime > 0.0) {\n
                    PRECISION vec2 p = (targetVec*_textureScaleInv - _shockWaveCenter) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect);\n
            float dis = max(length(p), 0.0001);\n
            float k = _shockWaveMaxDistVal != 0.0 ? clamp(1.0 - dis * _shockWaveMaxDistVal, 0.0, 1.0) : 1.0;\n
            if (_shockWaveInvert) dis = _shockWaveMaxSize - max(dis, _shockWaveMinSize);\n
            k *= clamp(smoothstep(_shockWaveTime1, _shockWaveTime2, dis) - smoothstep(_shockWaveTime3, _shockWaveTime4, dis), 0.0, 1.0);\n
            // Ripples equation multiplied with ring circles so that it will be shockwave\n
            targetVec += k * ((p/dis) * sin(dis * _shockWaveWaves - _shockWaveTime) * _shockWaveStrength) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SHOCKLINE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_shockLineTime != 0.0) {\n
            float dis = _shockLineAxis ? ((targetVec.y * _textureScaleInv.y - _shockLineCenter) * _screenAspect) : (targetVec.x * _textureScaleInv.x - _shockLineCenter);\n
                    \n
            float k = _shockLineMaxDistVal == 0.0 ? 1.0 : (clamp(1.0 + (dis < 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0) * dis * _shockLineMaxDistVal, 0.0, 1.0));\n
            if (_shockLineDual) dis = abs(dis);\n
            if (_shockLineDirection) dis = 1.0-dis;\n
                    k *= clamp(smoothstep(_shockLineTime1, _shockLineTime2, dis) - smoothstep(_shockLineTime3, _shockLineTime4, dis), 0.0, 1.0);\n
            targetVec += k * sin(dis*_shockLineWaves-_shockLineTime) * _shockLineStrength * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // BULGE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_bulgeValue > 0.0) {\n
                     PRECISION vec2 d = (targetVec*_textureScaleInv - _bulgeOrigin) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect);\n
            float di = length(d);\n
            if (di < _bulgeRadius) {\n
            float fadeValue = pow(di / _bulgeRadius, 3.0);\n
            vec2 bulgedVec = (_bulgeOrigin * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect) + normalize(d) * tan(sqrt(dot(d, d)) * _bulgeValue) * _bulgeValue2) * _textureScale * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            targetVec = targetVec * fadeValue + bulgedVec * (1.0 - fadeValue);\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // PINCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // Original function\n
            if (_pinchValue.x != 0.0 || _pinchValue.y != 0.0) {\n
                     PRECISION vec2 d = (targetVec*_textureScaleInv - _pinchCenterPos) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect);\n
            float di = length(d);\n
            if (di < _pinchRadius) {\n
            float fadeValue = pow(di / _pinchRadius, 2.0);\n
            vec2 pinchedVec = (_pinchCenterPos * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect) + normalize(d) * atan(sqrt(dot(d, d)) * -_pinchValue * 20.0) * _pinchCalc1) * _textureScale * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            targetVec = targetVec * fadeValue + pinchedVec * (1.0 - fadeValue);\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // GLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_glitchTop > 0.0) {\n
            // Random offset slices horizontally\n
            targetVec.x += _glitchXOffset * insideRange(targetVec.y, _glitchBot, _glitchTop);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SPLITSCREEN\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_colmod != 1.0 || _rowmod != 1.0) {\n
            float normalizedX = (targetVec.x - _splitXStart) * _splitXRangeMult;\n
            normalizedX = (normalizedX < 0.5*_textureScale.x) ? normalizedX * _colmod : (normalizedX * _colmod) + _colmodCalc;\n
            targetVec.x = _splitXStart + fract(normalizedX) * _splitXRange;\n
            float normalizedY = (targetVec.y - _splitYStart) * _splitYRangeMult;\n
            normalizedY = (normalizedY < 0.5*_textureScale.y) ? normalizedY * _rowmod : (normalizedY * _rowmod) + _rowmodCalc;\n
            targetVec.y = _splitYStart + fract(normalizedY) * _splitYRange;\n
            }\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // APPLY THE COLOR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            gl_FragColor = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec);\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // CHROMATICGLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_cGRGBOffset != 0.0) {\n
            float cVal = (v_texCoord.y+_cGYOffset)*50.0*_cGHeight;\n
            targetVec.x += (noise(vec2(_cGTime,cVal))-noise(vec2(0,cVal)))*_cGStrength;\n
            vec4 r = texture2D(CC_Texture0, vec2(targetVec.x - _cGRGBOffset, targetVec.y));\n
            vec4 g = texture2D(CC_Texture0, vec2(targetVec.x, targetVec.y));\n
            vec4 b = texture2D(CC_Texture0, vec2(targetVec.x + _cGRGBOffset, targetVec.y));\n
            vec3 color = vec3(r.r, g.g, b.b);\n
            if (_cGLineThick > 0.0) {\n
            color -= smoothstep(_cGLineThick - 0.01, _cGLineThick + 0.01, sin((v_texCoord.y+_cGYOffset)*300.0*_cGHeight))*_cGLineStrength;\n
            }\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4(color, (r.a+g.a+b.a)*0.3333);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // GLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_glitchTop > 0.0) {\n
            // Offset one channel\n
            if (_glitchRnd < 0.33) {\n
            vec4 col2 = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + _glitchColOffset);\n
            gl_FragColor.r = col2.r;\n
            gl_FragColor.a = max(gl_FragColor.a, col2.a);\n
            }\n
            else if (_glitchRnd < 0.66) {\n
            vec4 col2 = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + _glitchColOffset);\n
            gl_FragColor.g = col2.g;\n
            gl_FragColor.a = max(gl_FragColor.a, col2.a);\n
            }\n
            else {\n
            vec4 col2 = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + _glitchColOffset);\n
            gl_FragColor.b = col2.b;\n
            gl_FragColor.a = max(gl_FragColor.a, col2.a);\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // CHROMATIC\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_chromaticXOff != 0.0 || _chromaticYOff != 0.0) {\n
            vec4 r = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + vec2(_chromaticXOff, _chromaticYOff));\n
            vec4 b = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + vec2(-_chromaticXOff, -_chromaticYOff));\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4(r.r, gl_FragColor.g, b.b, max(r.a, max(gl_FragColor.a,b.a)));\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // RADIALBLUR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_radialBlurValue != 0.0) {\n
            vec4 result = gl_FragColor;\n
            if (!_blurOnlyEmpty || result.a < 0.1) {\n
            vec2 uv = targetVec;\n
            vec2 blurVector = (_radialBlurCenter - uv) * _radialBlurValue;\n
            float modVal = 1.0 + 4.5*_blurFade;\n
            result *= modVal;\n
            for (int i = 1; i < radialBlurSamples; i++) {\n
            modVal -= _blurFade;\n
            uv.xy += blurVector.xy;\n
                ^I^I^Iresult += texture2D(CC_Texture0, uv) * modVal;\n
            }\n
            result *= radialBlurSamplesInv;\n
            // Output to screen\n
            if (_blurUseRef) {\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4((result.rgb + _blurRefColor * (1.0-result.a)), result.a * _blurIntensity);\n
            }\n
            else gl_FragColor = result;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // MOTIONBLUR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            else if (_motionBlurValue.x != 0.0 || _motionBlurValue.y != 0.0) \n
            {\n
            //vec4 result = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec);\n
            vec4 result = gl_FragColor;\n
            if (!_blurOnlyEmpty || result.a < 0.1) {\n
            if (_motionBlurDual) {\n
            for (float i = 1.0; i < mbSamplesLoopDual; ++i) {\n
            float modVal = 1.0 - (i * _blurFade);\n
            vec2 offset = _motionBlurValue * (i * mbSamplesDualInv);\n
            result += texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + offset) * modVal;\n
            result += texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec - offset) * modVal;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            else {\n
            for (float i = 1.0; i < mbSamplesLoop; ++i) {\n
            float modVal = 1.0 - (i * _blurFade);\n
            vec2 offset = _motionBlurValue * (i * mbSamplesInv);\n
            result += texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + offset) * modVal;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            result *= _motionBlurMult; // 1/(9 - 20 * _blurFade)\n
            if (_blurUseRef) {\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4((result.rgb + _blurRefColor * (1.0-result.a)), result.a * _blurIntensity);\n
            }\n
            else gl_FragColor = result;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // GRAYSCALE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_grayscaleValue > 0.0) {\n
            float gray = !_grayscaleUseLum ? (gl_FragColor.r + gl_FragColor.g + gl_FragColor.b)*0.333 : dot(gl_FragColor.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb*(1.0-_grayscaleValue) + vec3(gray)*_grayscaleValue*_grayscaleTint;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SEPIA\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_sepiaValue > 0.0) {\n
            vec4 texColor = gl_FragColor * sepiaMat;\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb*(1.0-_sepiaValue) + texColor.rgb*_sepiaValue;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // INVERTCOLOR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_invertColorValue.a > 0.0) {\n
            vec4 texColor = 1.0 - gl_FragColor;\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb * (1.0 - _invertColorValue.rgb) + texColor.rgb * _invertColorValue.rgb;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // HUESHIFT\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_hueShiftCosA != 0.0) {\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = vec3(gl_FragColor.rgb * _hueShiftCosA + cross(_hueShiftK, gl_FragColor.rgb) * _hueShiftSinA + _hueShiftK * dot(_hueShiftK, gl_FragColor.rgb) * (1.0 - _hueShiftCosA));\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // COLORCHANGE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_colorChangeC.r > 0.0) {\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb * _colorChangeC + _colorChangeB;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // LENSCIRCLE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_lensCircleStrength > 0.0) {\n
                    float dist = distance(v_texCoord * _textureScaleInv * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect), _lensCircleOrigin);\n
                    float k = _lensCircleStart == _lensCircleEnd ? ((dist >= _lensCircleEnd ? _lensCircleStrength : 0.0)) : _lensCircleStrength * (1.0 - smoothstep(_lensCircleEnd, _lensCircleStart, dist));\n
            if (_lensCircleAdditive) gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb + (_lensCircleTint * k);\n
            else gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb * (1.0 - k) + (_lensCircleTint * k);\n
            }\n
            }\n

  [ 664c9]  Allow Multi-Rotation
  [ 664de]  Allows multiple rotation actions to run on the same target group. This was not possible before 2.2.
  [ 66542]  Enable 2.2 Changes
  [ 66555]  Legacy compatibility pre 2.2. Should be enabled on new levels.
  [ 66594]  Allow Static-Rotate
  [ 665a8]  Allow rotating static objects in actions and animations. There is currently no support for rotating static objects other than 90 degree steps, but use this option to allow it anyway. Hitboxes will not match the art. Can be useful in some cases.
  [ 6669d]  Enable Player Squeeze
  [ 666b3]  Destroys player when squeezed between two objects. This is on by default but only for levels after update 2.2 for legacy reasons. Cannot be disabled for platformer levels.
  [ 6675f]  Fix Gravity Bug
  [ 6676f]  Fixes an old bug that makes flipped gravity act differently than normal gravity. Old levels can break with this enabled.
  [ 667e8]  Fix Negative Scale
  [ 667fb]  Makes negative scaled objects collide correctly. Disabled on old levels for compatibility.
  [ 66856]  Fix Robot Jump
  [ 66865]  Fixes robot jumps being bugged on slopes and/or pads.
  [ 6689b]  Dynamic Level Height
  [ 668b0]  Increases max level height dynamically (the same way as max length). This option is always enabled in platformer mode.
  [ 66927]  Sort Groups
  [ 66933]  Makes sure that spawn groups are triggered in the correct order (left to right).
  [ 66984]  Fix Radius Collision
  [ 66999]  Replaces the player hitbox with a circle (instead of a square) for interactions with circular hitboxes. This fixes some issues where collisions would not register.
  [ 66a3d]  Reverse Sync
  [ 66a4a]  Slows down or speeds up the player when reversing direction using orb or pads to keep music in sync.
  [ 66aaf]  Decrease Boost Slide
  [ 66ac4]  Slide less after dashing or being launched by moving blocks in platformer mode.
  [ 66b14]  Enable Impulse Fix
  [ 66b27]  Fix moving platform impulse bugs in platformer mode.

  [ 67031]  Setup Keyframe
  [ 67040]  Setup Keyframe %i
  [ 67052]  <cg>GroupID</c> needs to contain a group parent.\n
            <cy>Duration</c> is time before next keyframe.\n
            <cl>x360</c> lets you do full rotations before next keyframe.\n
            <ca>CCW/CW</c> to force rotation in a direction.\n
            <cp>SpawnGID</c> lets you spawn a group at the keyframe.\n
            <cg>Prox</c> will spawn the group when close to the keyframe.\n
            <cr>Curve</c> uses cubic interpolation to the next keyframe.\n
            <co>Close Loop</c> returns to the first keyframe after the last.\n
            <ca>Preview Art</c> lets you preview the Group ID instead of an icon.\n
            <cl>Ref Only</c> will only be used as an inbetween frame.\n
            <co>Even</c> = time between each keyframe is duration / keyframes.\n
            <cr>Dist</c> = time between each keyframe is distance / keyframes.
